title: Mini-games

streak.title: Weekly streak

streak.todayHint: Finish any mini-game to count today
streak.rewardHint: Reach a 7-day streak in any mini-games to get a free promotion

help.title: How to play
help.intro: Compare two listings and guess which one costs more.
help.known: The left price is already known
help.hidden: The right price stays hidden until you answer
help.choose: Pick “Higher” or “Lower” for the right listing
help.outro: After your answer we reveal both prices — and both listings open.

notEnoughItems.title: Not enough listings
notEnoughItems.hint: More listings with photos are needed to start the game

bukovki.listingsEmpty: No matching listings are available right now

help.title: How to play
help.intro: Guess the word taken from a real listing title.
help.correct: Letter is in the right spot
help.present: Letter is in the word, elsewhere
help.absent: Letter is not in the word
help.outro: After the round we show listings with this word.

raccoonjump.name: Noti Jump
raccoonjump.description: Jump from platform to platform as high as you can

help.title: How to play
help.intro: Help Noti climb as high as possible — do not fall down.
help.touch: Mobile: tap the left or right side
help.platforms: Springs launch you higher, fragile platforms break
help.outro: The higher you climb, the more points — your best score is saved.
